methods.BASELINE_1_MANUAL: hard-coded DELETEs of customer_address, loyalty_account, ticket_message (via the subject's tickets), support_ticket, document, customer in ONE transaction; no knowledge of derived artifacts, caches, embeddings, hidden copies or retention
